description: This file defines serialization and copying logic for ImmutableHashSet<T> in Orleans Serialization framework. It includes a serializer, surrogate, and copier classes specific to ImmutableHashSet<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableHashSet<T> using surrogate pattern.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type for ImmutableHashSet<T> storing values and key comparer.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableHashSet<T> supporting optional deep copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableHashSet<T>.
